Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🐔 Ingredients Chicken: • 1.1 lb (500 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces • 1 egg • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp ginger powder • ½ tsp chicken bouillon • 5 tbsp cornstarch • 3 tbsp all-purpose flour Sauce: • 1.5 tbsp butter • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1.5 tbsp gochujang • 3 tbsp ketchup • 1 tbsp soy sauce • 2 tbsp light brown sugar • 1 tbsp honey • 2 tsp rice vinegar • 1 tsp sesame oil Garnish: • Toasted sesame seeds • Sliced green onions Instructions: 1. Season the chicken with the egg, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, ginger powder, and chicken bouillon. Mix well and let rest for 10 minutes. 2. Add the cornstarch and flour, then toss until evenly coated. 3. Fry at 320–330°F (160–165°C) until cooked through. Let rest for 2–3 minutes. 4. Fry again at 355°F (180°C) until golden and crispy. 5. Melt the butter and saute the garlic until fragrant. 6. Add the gochujang, ketchup, soy sauce, light brown sugar, honey, rice vinegar, and sesame oil. Cook until glossy. 7. Toss the chicken in the sauce until evenly coated. 8. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions. #chickenrecipes #koreanfood #popcorn #chicken #fyp

Recipe 👇🏼 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak Carbonara ramen ½ cup heavy cream ½–1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 4–5 dumplings (potstickers/mandu) Mini sausages or cocktail sausages Green onions, chopped Chili oil (optional) Instructions Cook the dumplings and sausages separately until heated through and lightly browned. Set aside. Boil the Buldak noodles according to the package instructions. When the noodles are halfway cooked, drain most of the water, leaving a little in the pan. Pour in the heavy cream and stir well until creamy and smooth. Add the Buldak sauce packet and powder seasoning, then mix everything together until fully combined and coated. Let it simmer for about 1 minute so the noodles absorb all the flavor. Add mozzarella cheese and let it melt into the ramen until extra cheesy and creamy. Top with the dumplings, sausages, chopped green onions, and a drizzle of chili oil for extra heat. Ultra Creamy Buldak Ramen 🍝🥟 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 1–2 tbsp butter 2 cloves garlic (minced) 1 tbsp Kewpie mayo Buldak sauce packet Buldak powder packet 1 tbsp chili oil ¾–1 cup heavy cream Mozzarella cheese Dumplings Sausages Green onions Sesame seeds Extra chili oil (for topping) Instructions Cook noodles until al dente, then drain and set aside. In a pan, melt butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add Kewpie mayo, Buldak sauce, and powder packet. Mix well until it turns thick and glossy. Add chili oil and stir. Pour in heavy cream and mix until smooth, creamy, and slightly thickened (that rich orange color 🔥). Add noodles and toss until fully coated. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top and let it melt into the sauce. Add dumplings and sausages on top. Cover and let everything heat through. Finish with green onions, sesame seeds, and extra chili oil drizzle. . #buldak #buldakramen #eat #cook #Foodie
